name: Habits
description: Track daily habits alongside your diary.
title: Habits
remindersDescription: Saved on this device only, like the diary's other reminders.
reminderDescription: A nudge if the day's habits are still untouched.
exportKeyDone: a box that was ticked. Every other kind prints what was actually recorded.
exportKeyMissed: the habit was asked about on that day, and nothing was recorded.
exportKeyUnscheduled: the habit was still being kept, but its schedule does not fall on that day.
exportKeyUntracked: An empty cell means the habit was not being tracked on that day at all — it had not been created yet, or it had already been retired.
exportKeyTask: A task that is not done keeps being asked about on the days after the one it was due on, so those days count as asked too.
exportOnlyRecordedDays: Only days something was recorded on have a row. A date missing from the table was never written on.
emptyPageDescription: Track anything you want to keep an eye on day to day — a yes/no, or an amount.
turnOffDescription: The habits section disappears from every device. Nothing you have recorded is deleted, and turning it back on brings it all back.
nothingScheduled: Nothing to track on this day.
typeBinaryHint: A box you tick — did it happen today.
typeNumericHint: Something you count: push-ups, glasses of water, pages.
typeTimeHint: Minutes and hours, with a stopwatch you can run while you do it.
typeScaleHint: Something you judge rather than count, on a sliding scale.
typeTaskHint: Something to get done. Left undone, it carries over to the following days as overdue.
monthDayHint: In shorter months, the last day stands in.
intervalHint: Counted from the day the habit was created.
typeFixed: The kind cannot be changed — past values would mean something different.
dayLockedPast: This day is in the past, so values are locked. Tap to make changes.
dayLockedFuture: This day hasn't happened yet, so values are locked. Tap to make changes.
dayUnlockedHint: Unlocked for editing. Tap to lock this day again.

add.title: Add your habits
add.lede: Habits are created on their own page, separate from the day you're writing — a name, and one of six ways to track it.
add.previewNote: Just a preview — nothing here is saved.

types.title: Six ways to track
types.lede: Every habit is one of these six kinds — the same controls you'll use on the day page.

calendar.title: See it on the calendar
calendar.lede: Once its tab is picked, the Calendar page shades every day by how many of that day's habits were met.

widget.title: Add it to your home screen
widget.lede: On Android, a Habits widget lets you tick habits without opening the app — it keeps itself up to date on its own.
widget.label: Home screen widget
widget.note: Long-press your home screen, choose Widgets, and add Habits.
